prerequisites: Competences taught in the basic modules Object-Oriented Programming and Algorithms and Data Structures are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can report on new research results from current scientific contributions in national and international journals and from conferences in the field of software development.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Contents of recent research in the field of system development. The specific technical orientation of the module is determined by the lecturer.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (minimum 50 percent of points)
Oral presentation of the solution of at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: Assessment is based on a point scale from 0 to 15, according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The final examination is either an oral exam or a written exam.
